name: Clawpage Agent
subtitle: AI that gets your tasks done
promotionalText: Describe what you need. Clawpage Agent's AI researches, uses web pages and organizes files for you, with progress and results in one chat you can add to anytime.
whatsNew: First iOS release: main chat, task browser, workspace and voice input. The app opens your last page even when you are offline.
description:
Clawpage Agent is your AI workspace. Describe what you need in the main chat; the AI researches, uses web pages and organizes files, and you can follow progress, review results and add instructions at any time.

• Main chat: submit tasks, follow progress, read results; follow-ups continue the same task.
• Task browser: see the pages the AI is using, take over when needed, then hand control back.
• Workspace: browse task files and open generated documents and materials.
• Scheduled tasks: let the AI check, summarize and remind you on a schedule.
• Voice input: tap the microphone and speak; your words become a draft you review before sending.
• Photos and attachments: take a photo or video, or pick a file, and attach it to your message.
• Account and content support: report an AI reply in the app, or request deletion of your account and associated data under Account & privacy.

The interface supports English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese; choose your language in Settings.
Register and sign in with your email and password. Once the service reaches its account limit, new registrations need an invitation code; existing accounts sign in directly. An internet connection is required; tasks run on the Clawpage Agent service and its configured AI providers.

AI replies may be inaccurate and are for general information only; verify important results. Clawpage Agent is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Consult qualified professionals for medical, legal or investment advice.
